resources.string: One safe place for the family\'s documents, cards and links.

You leave every space and your documents are deleted with you. A space with nobody else in it is deleted. A space you share goes on without you; if you own it, the next adult becomes its owner. Your Google account is not touched. Google will ask you to choose your account once more.

Lock a document behind it. The other adults in your spaces then need the PIN to see it, and so do you.
